priority: Lag-putting ladder: balls at 30, 40 and 50 ft, 10 putts from each, count how many finish within 3 ft past the hole, then hole out. Twice a week for about 15 minutes, plus 5 minutes before each round.
criterion: Putts above expectation (given greens hit) at or below 5 per 18 holes over the next 54 holes.
